title: Build the mel scale and a mel filterbank
brief: Write the HTK and Slaney mel formulas, their inverses, and a triangular mel filterbank that matches librosa's.
hints: np.where(f >= 1000, log_branch, linear_branch) evaluates both branches everywhere, so wrap the log's argument in np.maximum(f, 1000) to keep ln(0) out of the unused branch.
The Slaney break point on the mel axis is 15 mel, not 1000. Invert the linear branch below 15 and the log branch at and above it.
Build all the filters at once with broadcasting: edges[:-2, None], edges[1:-1, None], and edges[2:, None] against bin_hz[None, :], then np.maximum(0, np.minimum(rising, falling)).
The FFT bin frequencies are np.linspace(0, sample_rate / 2, n_fft // 2 + 1). The triangles are straight lines in Hz, not in mel.
